title: HPE ProLiant m510 Moonshot cartridge: 2 x M.2 NVMe and 1 x M.2 SATA on board, plus a 2 x M.2 carrier card
notes: The two on-board NVMe M.2 slots are PCIe hotplug slots 1 and 2. The SATA M.2 is on port 5 of the chipset's AHCI controller. The carrier card sits in the slot the firmware calls PCI-E Slot 6 and carries a PCIe switch whose ports 00.0 and 08.0 each hold an M.2; which port is which physical position on the card has not been checked, so the two are named by port.

bays.note: carrier card M.2 behind switch port 00.0; physical position unverified
carrier card M.2 behind switch port 08.0; physical position unverified
